_note: The one place a file or import is allowed to stay outside the number-literal ratchet and the JSON-import rule. Read by scripts/number-literal-gate.mjs and scripts/as-data-gate.mjs in CI, not by the game. One entry per pattern, each with a reason; adding or widening an entry needs Strategy's approval. Patterns are matched against paths relative to Web/src.

numberExemptFiles.reason: procedural pickup, vest and saw models: vertex, radius and offset numbers of a mesh. Other *-view.js files mix in timings and opacities and are counted
procedural model geometry for the drone, the feral dog and the pistol slide
hand and finger pose offsets of the pistol grip (rig-space geometry)

jsonImportAllowed.reason: frozen donor motion captures (clip and blade-path tables), not tuning

lazy physics chunk data (about 230 KB of skin vertices per boss, written from the GLBs by tools/physics-floor-support.mjs), read only by physics-death-impl.js; routing it through GAME_DATA would put it in the main bundle
frozen per-animal motion captures (clips, blade paths, foot bindings), not tuning
